content_sections.heading: Siddipet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Release Date: 04-08-2026 Online Application Start Date: 05-08-2026 (from 10:30 AM) Online Application Last Date: 15-08-2026 (up to 5:00 PM) The official notification does not mention separate dates for admit card release, exam date or interview schedule. Candidates are advised to keep checking wdcw.tg.nic.in for further updates on the selection schedule.

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Anganwadi Teacher & Helper Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancies have been announced ICDS project-wise across five projects in Siddipet district. The table below shows the project-wise break-up of Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper (Tribal) vacancies. Every Anganwadi Centre (AWC) reserved under the NC Sub-Plan is categorised as NC Group-I, Group-II or Group-III based on the ICDS project's tribal population profile. Eligible candidates belonging to the designated group for a particular AWC are given first preference. If eligible candidates are not available within the designated group, candidates from other NC sub-plan groups are considered as per reservation rules. For vacancies under NC Group-I, NC Group-II and NC Group-III, candidates from any eligible NC sub-plan group can be considered for selection when suitable candidates are not available within the designated group.

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Anganwadi Teacher & Helper Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: As on 01-07-2026, candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age. The candidate must be a resident of the division of the concerned Anganwadi Centre (in urban areas) or the Gram Panchayat (in rural areas) to which the post relates. For Anganwadi Teacher posts reserved under the ST register in NC/NT (Tribal) areas, only eligible candidates residing in the respective Gram Panchayat/habitation are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Siddipet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) and Anganwadi Helper (AWH): Minimum qualification of Intermediate / 12th class pass is required. Relaxation for AWH post: If candidates with Intermediate/12th class qualification are not available for a particular Anganwadi Helper post, candidates with the next lower qualification (SSC/10th class) will be considered for selection, as per G.O.Ms.No.37. content_sections.heading: Siddipet Anganwadi Teacher & Helper Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection of candidates will be based on the following criteria and marks distribution: Note: Marks under special categories (Orphans, Orphanage/Destitute residents, PwD) are applicable only to eligible candidates falling under those categories, in addition to Intermediate merit marks and interview marks.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: The official notification does not provide an explicit checklist of documents. Based on the eligibility and selection criteria mentioned in the notification, candidates are generally expected to keep the following ready for verification, subject to confirmation on the official application portal: Intermediate/12th class or SSC/10th class marks memo Proof of residence (relevant to the Anganwadi Centre division or Gram Panchayat) Caste certificate, wherever applicable for NC Sub-Plan/reservation categories Orphan/destitute home residence certificate, wherever applicable Disability certificate, wherever applicable Recent passport-size photograph This list is indicative only. Candidates must follow the exact document requirements specified on the online application portal at wdcw.tg.nic.in.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Siddipet Anganwadi Teacher & Helper Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: wdcw.tg.nic.in Locate the online application link for Siddipet Anganwadi Teacher/Helper Recruitment 2026. Register and fill in the online application form with personal, educational and local residence details. Upload the required certificates as per the instructions on the portal. Review the filled application carefully before final submission. Submit the application within the specified window, i.e., between 05-08-2026 (10:30 AM) and 15-08-2026 (5:00 PM). Save/download a copy of the submitted application for future reference. Important: Applications will be accepted only through the online mode on wdcw.tg.nic.in. Applications submitted through CDPO/DWO offices, by post, or by e-mail will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Siddipet Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit online applications along with all supporting documents relating to age, educational qualification, residence and category (Gazetted Officer attested, wherever required), belonging to the concerned ICDS project. Applications must be submitted only through the online portal; postal, e-mail or in-person applications will not be accepted. The District Collector/Chairman, District Selection Committee, Siddipet District, has full authority to cancel or amend this notification. Candidates are advised to regularly check the official website wdcw.tg.nic.in for updates and further instructions. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Siddipet Anganwadi Teacher & Helper Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 15-08-2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many Anganwadi Teacher and Helper posts are vacant in Siddipet district?
faq.answer: There are 78 Anganwadi Teacher vacancies and 13 Anganwadi Helper (Tribal) vacancies, totalling 91 posts across five ICDS projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Siddipet Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01-07-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Teacher and Anganwadi Helper posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate/12th class pass. For Anganwadi Helper posts, if no Intermediate-qualified candidates are available, SSC/10th class qualified candidates may be considered as per G.O.Ms.No.37.
